notes: DiscoFlate v3.84.7 — 📱 THE ANDROID APP BOOTS AGAIN. It has been unbootable since v3.79.0: app.py started importing media_len.py, nobody added that file to the APK's hand-listed module set, and the import threw before the server could bind — so the app sat on "booting local server" until it timed out. Invisible on desktop, where the file is simply there. Fixed, and check.sh now parses the imports of every shipped module and fails the build if one isn't in the list, so the list cannot silently drift again.
